name: JPEG 2000 9x7 Wavelet Kernel
definition: A biorthogonal cubic B-spline variation with vanishing moments (6 and 2) divided equally between analysis and synthesis sides, offering nearly orthogonal basis functions.
summary: The JPEG 2000 9x7 Wavelet Kernel is a biorthogonal transform for lossy volumetric compression that offers improved energy compaction over the 5x3 kernel.
